status: Commerce now writes Finance-owned order-revision Money evidence in the same serializable transaction as the native quotation/sales-order draft save, and the post-save navigation refreshes the hub and opens the exact created quotation/sales document. Desktop and mobile browser journeys created and edited quotations through the native Next route with persisted order, line and 1+3N Money rows. The quotation workflow closes; sales orders, cancellations and fulfillment remain separate.

scope.financePort: Finance owns lock_commerce_order_money_sources and snapshot_commerce_order_revision. It locks company_currency_scales, company_fx_rates and money_transaction_snapshots in a stable order, verifies the serializable unit and exact lock modes, resolves the configured ISO scale and effective-date confirmed quote (fallback recorded), converts to USD with exact rounding, writes the order total plus each line's unit_price/subtotal/tax under source ids ${id}:${version}, re-reads every persisted row and re-verifies the unit.
scope.composition: The native Commerce save acquires the Finance locks before the owner write, runs save_order_outcome, then calls Finance snapshot on the same connection. A replay returns plan=None and never duplicates Money rows. Any persistence or revalidation failure rolls the order, receipt, audit, outbox and Money rows back together.
scope.frontend: useCommerceCommand now builds the quotation or sales-document destination from the submitted kind, uses the record drawer result and refreshes after the drawer route is active so the created/edit result and the list are read again.
scope.legacyRetained: Purchase orders, request/RFQ handoffs, sales-order approval Finance credit guard, confirmed sales cancellation Inventory reversal guard, fulfillment, invoicing, settlement and returns remain retained and are outside sales/quotes.

verification.commerce: cargo test -p erpx-server-commerce --locked: 61/61 pass across 5 unit/8 PostgreSQL/25 policy/7 HTTP/15 order PostgreSQL/1 service-count suites.
